description: Phase 1 — Wire Protocol Engine: implement stream_decoder.py, coordinate.py, rpc_templates.py, and readiness_poller.py plus their unit tests and golden fixtures. Depends on FEAT-001 (package layout). Independent of FEAT-003/004/005/006.
steps: Create src/mcp_gateway/engine/stream_decoder.py. Implement: (a) Class BatchexecuteStreamDecoder with method feed(chunk: bytes) -> list[dict]. Maintains an internal bytes buffer. On each feed(): strips leading ')]}\n' anti-XSSI prefix on the very first call only (stateful flag). Appends chunk to buffer. Calls _extract_frames() which attempts json.loads on progressively larger windows to find complete JSON arrays; on success extracts all 'wrb.fr' records (index 0 == 'wrb.fr') returning parsed inner JSON, and extracts 'e' error frames (index 0 == 'e') raising StreamDecodeError. Returns list of decoded dicts. (b) Class GenerateFreeFormStreamParser with method feed(chunk: bytes) -> list[dict]. Handles server-sent gRPC-web chunked text: accumulates lines, each non-empty line after stripping is a JSON array; extracts text delta records and citation coordinate records. Returns list of dicts with keys 'type' ('text_delta'|'citation'|'done') and relevant payload fields. (c) Exception class StreamDecodeError(Exception) with field error_code: int. (d) All classes fully type-annotated. No logging of raw response bodies. File: /path/to/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/engine/stream_decoder.py

Create src/mcp_gateway/engine/coordinate.py. Implement: (a) Function utf16_to_unicode_offset(text: str, utf16_offset: int) -> int — encodes text as utf-16-le, slices to utf16_offset*2 bytes, decodes back, returns len(). (b) Function utf16_slice(text: str, start: int, end: int) -> str — encodes text as utf-16-le, slices [start*2 : end*2], decodes with errors='replace'. (c) Dataclass (frozen=True) CitationSpan with fields: source_id: str, start_char: int, end_char: int, text_snippet: str. (d) Function normalize_citation(raw: dict[str, Any], source_text: str) -> CitationSpan — extracts raw start/end UTF-16 offsets from the raw dict, calls utf16_to_unicode_offset for both, calls utf16_slice for the snippet. Raises ValueError if offsets are negative or end < start. File: /path/to/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/engine/coordinate.py

Create src/mcp_gateway/engine/rpc_templates.py. Implement: (a) Dataclass (frozen=True) BatchexecuteRequest with fields: rpc_id: str, params_json: str, notebook_id: str | None, authuser: int. Method to_form_body(csrf_token: str) -> str — builds URL-encoded f.req body as f.req=[[[rpc_id, params_json, null, 'generic']]}&at={csrf_token}; NEVER interpolates csrf_token or cookie values into log strings. (b) Functions for each RPC payload — all return str (JSON-stringified): make_list_notebooks_payload(page_size: int = 58) -> str, make_get_metadata_payload(notebook_id: str) -> str, make_add_url_payload(url: str, notebook_id: str) -> str, make_add_text_payload(title: str, content: str) -> str, make_add_drive_payload(doc_id: str, mime_type: str, title: str, notebook_id: str) -> str, make_register_upload_payload(filename: str, notebook_id: str) -> str, make_delete_source_payload(source_id: str) -> str. (c) Function make_query_params(sources: list[str], question: str, notebook_id: str, session_id: str | None, message_id: str, history: list[tuple[str,str]]) -> str — builds the GenerateFreeFormStreamed params JSON with triple-nested source IDs (depth=2), newest-first conversation history, verbosity=120, origin=1. (d) Constant BATCHEXECUTE_URL = 'https://notebook.google.com/_/LabsTailwindUi/data/batchexecute'. Constant QUERY_URL = 'https://notebook.google.com/_/LabsTailwindUi/data/google.internal.labs.tailwind.orchestration.v1.LabsTailwindOrchestrationService/GenerateFreeFormStreamed'. No secrets ever included in any template. File: /path/to/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/engine/rpc_templates.py

Create src/mcp_gateway/engine/readiness_poller.py. Implement: (a) Enum SourceStatus(IntEnum): UNKNOWN=-1, PROCESSING=1, READY=2, ERROR=3, PREPARING=5. (b) Function parse_source_status(source_row: list[Any]) -> SourceStatus — defensively scans indices 3, 4, 5 of source_row for an integer value matching SourceStatus members; returns UNKNOWN if none found. (c) Async function poll_until_ready(notebook_id: str, source_id: str, fetch_metadata_fn: Callable[[str], Awaitable[list[Any]]], max_timeout: float = 300.0, base_delay: float = 2.0, max_delay: float = 30.0) -> SourceStatus — implements Full Jitter Exponential Backoff: delay = random.uniform(0, min(base_delay * (2 ** attempt), max_delay)); calls fetch_metadata_fn(notebook_id) to get source rows, finds the row matching source_id, calls parse_source_status; returns READY on success; raises TimeoutError after max_timeout seconds; returns ERROR if status is ERROR; never raises on UNKNOWN — keeps polling. File: /path/to/Google Notebook MCP/src/mcp_gateway/engine/readiness_poller.py

Create tests/fixtures/golden_wire_captures.json at /path/to/Google Notebook MCP/tests/fixtures/golden_wire_captures.json. Contains a JSON object with these keys: 'antixssi_single_frame': a bytes-as-hex-string of a complete batchexecute response with )]}\n prefix and one wrb.fr record (notebook list), 'fragmented_two_chunks': array of two hex strings that together form one complete wrb.fr record (tests reassembly), 'error_frame_132': a batchexecute response containing an 'e' error frame with error code 132, 'non_ascii_citation': a GenerateFreeFormStreamed response line containing a citation with astral-plane characters (emoji) in the source text, with known correct UTF-16 offsets and expected Python Unicode slice. Use synthetic data only — NO real notebook IDs, NO real session cookies, NO real SNlM0e tokens.

Create tests/test_stream_decoder.py at /path/to/Google Notebook MCP/tests/test_stream_decoder.py. Tests: (a) test_antixssi_strip — feeds golden 'antixssi_single_frame' hex bytes, asserts one decoded dict returned, asserts wrb.fr record decoded correctly. (b) test_fragment_reassembly — feeds two chunks separately, asserts no result after first chunk, asserts one result after second chunk. (c) test_error_frame_raises — feeds 'error_frame_132' bytes, asserts StreamDecodeError raised with error_code==132. (d) test_gffs_citation_extraction — feeds 'non_ascii_citation' bytes to GenerateFreeFormStreamParser, asserts at least one 'citation' type dict returned.

Create tests/test_coordinate.py at /path/to/Google Notebook MCP/tests/test_coordinate.py. Tests: (a) test_ascii_roundtrip — utf16_slice('hello world', 0, 5) == 'hello'. (b) test_astral_offset — text containing emoji (e.g. 'Hi 😀 end'), verify utf16_to_unicode_offset with known UTF-16 offset returns correct Python char index. (c) test_utf16_slice_with_astral — verify utf16_slice on same emoji text returns correct substring. (d) test_normalize_citation_valid — construct a raw citation dict, call normalize_citation, assert CitationSpan fields correct. (e) test_normalize_citation_invalid_offsets — assert ValueError raised for end < start. Use the non_ascii_citation fixture from golden_wire_captures.json for ground truth.

Update src/mcp_gateway/engine/__init__.py to export: BatchexecuteStreamDecoder, GenerateFreeFormStreamParser, StreamDecodeError, CitationSpan, normalize_citation, utf16_to_unicode_offset, utf16_slice, SourceStatus, poll_until_ready, BatchexecuteRequest, make_query_params, BATCHEXECUTE_URL, QUERY_URL.
acceptance_criteria: uv run mypy --strict src/mcp_gateway/engine/ reports zero errors
uv run pytest tests/test_stream_decoder.py tests/test_coordinate.py -v — all tests pass
golden_wire_captures.json contains no real cookies, SNlM0e values, or ya29 tokens (audit manually)
utf16_slice with a string containing U+1F600 (emoji, 2 UTF-16 code units) returns the correct Python substring
findings: Implemented all 4 engine modules + __init__.py exports + golden fixture + 9 tests (4 stream_decoder, 5 coordinate). Added py.typed marker to src/mcp_gateway/ and mypy_path/explicit_package_bases to pyproject.toml to resolve src-layout mypy dual-module detection. All acceptance criteria met: mypy --strict zero errors, all 9 tests pass, no real session data in fixtures, utf16_slice emoji test verified.
